text:
Dollar Coins Worth Money
Modern dollar coins — Eisenhower, Susan B. Anthony, Sacagawea and Presidential dollars — are generally worth their face value, with no precious-metal content. The exceptions are the 40% silver collector Eisenhower dollars and a few notable errors.

Which dollar coins are worth money
Circulating modern dollar coins are worth $1 (face).
40% silver collector Eisenhower dollars (1971–1976) carry a silver melt value.
Errors are the prize: the 2000 Sacagawea "Cheerios" dollar and Sacagawea/Quarter "mule" are major rarities.
Susan B. Anthony "wide rim" (near date) 1979-P trades at a premium.
